<thought>Based on the 1H NMR data (acetyl methyl, two benzylic CH₂ groups, and nine aromatic protons consistent with a para‑substituted acetophenone bearing a phenylethyl group), the most plausible structure is 4‑(phenylethyl)acetophenone. Its SMILES notation is “CC(=O)c1ccc(cc1)CCc2ccccc2”.</thought>
<final_answer>CC(=O)c1ccc(cc1)CCc2ccccc2</final_answer>
